# Real ticket corpus

Read-only copies of this repository's own Flashheart tickets (project
`Flashheart`, key `FH`), taken unchanged on 2026-10-13: handoffs, dated
notes, answered questions, a bug's Reproduction and long sections, as
agents and people really write them. Tests check that a field or section
edit leaves every other byte of each file as it was (FH-66). Never edit
these files to suit a test; add another copy instead.
